newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Spot prices steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Spot prices steady to firmer.

text.p: Spot millfeed values remained mostly steady to firmer on Tuesday as the market gears up for the upcoming holiday period, dealers said.
"People are slowly looking at their calendar and noticing that the holidays are coming," a Kansas dealer said.
Therefore there is a tightness in supply but demand seems to be steady, he said.
Supplies are real tight between here and the end of the year with the holiday runs being slowed down quite a bit, another dealer said.
Feed mills run everyday except for Christmas and New Years Day but the flour mills will be taking some downtime which will create a bit of a supply shortage, he added.
In Buffalo, N.Y., trade was quiet.

"We are getting closer to the holiday season and I think the direction is generally for just a little bit of firmness," a Buffalo broker said. "But there is not a great deal of activity in the trades. He noted that demand remained steady.
"Business has slowed. It is not as nearly as active as it was," a Texas dealer said, referring to the warmer weather in parts of Texas.
"Feedmixers are pretty much covered," a St Louis dealer said. "I think that the spot loads they need here and there was pushing the market up."
